entries.title: The Shattering of Ignis
entries.body:
Ignis, the magical flame that sustained the kingdom's wards and guardians, has shattered. The wards have fallen, and twisted guardians now attack the people they once protected.

You command an expedition from the last haven. Carry the last ember in your lantern, recover the Ignis Shards held by mighty foes, and rekindle the kingdom's fire.

entries.title: The Twisted Woods
entries.body:
An Ignis Shard stirs inside Ashmane, swelling the forest beasts to monstrous size.
Lantern in hand, the expedition crosses the wardless woods to reclaim it.

entries.title: The Forest's First Shard
entries.body:
With Ashmane defeated, the swollen forest beasts grow calm.
The expedition carries the first Ignis Shard toward the castle.

entries.title: The Twisted Gate
entries.body:
After Ignis shattered, the gate golem was trapped in its last guard order.
It sees returning people as foes; the expedition seeks the Ignis Shard within the castle.

entries.title: The Silenced Gate Golem
entries.body:
The twisted golem stops, and the gate's ward briefly returns.
With the second Ignis Shard in their lantern, they head for the smoke-choked mine.

entries.title: The Furnace That Won't Stop
entries.body:
Bound to an Ignis Shard, the furnace guardian smelts iron without end.
The expedition crosses the burning cartway to reclaim the fire it holds.

entries.title: A Clue to the Next Flame
entries.body:
The furnace guardian stops, and a third Ignis Shard is reclaimed.
The shard points to the next destination; the journey goes on.
